description: Pinned toolchain for the HarmonyOS experiment. Blank-HAP stage verified with the 3.41.9 line; the full application needs the 3.47.7 preview line, which is where the port is currently blocked (see doc/distribution/harmonyos.zh.md).

verifiedHap.note: produced by tool/harmonyos/build_blank_hap.py from a cold work directory

fullAppStage.pubspecConstraint: flutter: '>=3.47.7-0 <3.47.8' (the OHOS preview is a pre-release, so the exact pin must be relaxed)
fullAppStage.blocked: TargetPlatform.ohos is not exhaustively matched by switch statements in pub packages (168 compile errors, starting with material_ui-1.2.0) and in lib/.

env.note: HVIGOR_USER_HOME and USERPROFILE must point inside the workspace on machines that deny writes under the real user profile.
